import pandas as pd
import os

path = "budget.xlsx"
print("exists:", os.path.exists(path))

if os.path.exists(path):
    xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
    print("sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
    for name in xl.sheet_names:
        df = xl.parse(name, header=None)
        print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} (shape {df.shape}) ===")
        print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=30))

import sys
import pandas as pd

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
grand = 0.0
for name in xl.sheet_names:
    df = xl.parse(name, header=None)
    print(f"--- {name} shape={df.shape} ---")
    print(df.to_string())
    numeric = df.select_dtypes("number")
    sheet_sum = float(numeric.to_numpy().sum()) if numeric.size else 0.0
    print(f"[sheet_sum:{name}] = {sheet_sum}")
    grand += sheet_sum
print("GRAND_TOTAL_ALL_SHEETS =", grand)

import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} (shape={df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=200, max_cols=30))
    print()
